title: Spinal Morphine for Postoperative Analgesia in Urology
brief_summary: The study was performed in urology patients elicited for open prostatectomy or open nephrectomy. Comparison of analgesic effect between group (M) with spinal morphine before general anaesthesia and group without this intervention was measured.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria

* elicited open prostatectomy or open nephrectomy

Exclusion Criteria

* drug or alcohol dependence
* psychiatric drug use
* ASA classification IV or V
* general contraindication to neuroaxial injection
